core_obligations: Extend the bottom row of the pull diagram by the cartesian square defining Y and verify the stated diagram properties.
Reduce to the two compositions a, b : Y -> R over the top row using that s is flat and surjective.
Observe a_0 = b_0 and that one of a, b is an isomorphism (s composed with delta is an automorphism).
Conclude via the composition-compatibility diagram for a_0^* C_{R0/R} with vertical isomorphisms from the deform lemma.
proof_roadmap: Set up the extended diagram with the cartesian square, run the flat-surjective reduction, and close with the commutative conormal-compatibility diagram whose vertical maps are isomorphisms.
difficulty_reason: The argument is a genuine diagram chase through three commutative squares; the reduction step and the compatibility conclusion are each non-trivial.
